# Chekki AI

> Chekki AI is a homework and classroom automation platform for Korean families and English-language academies (hagwons). It has two products: a free/paid consumer app for parents and children (AI worksheet scanning, answer checking, pronunciation coaching), and a B2B academy platform that turns Foreign Teacher (FT) class logs into Korean-language KakaoTalk parent updates automatically, reviewed by a Korean Teacher (KT) before sending.

## For families
- Parents scan a child's completed paper worksheet with the app; Chekki AI (Google Gemini multimodal OCR) checks answers against any academy workbook or commercial publisher without fixed templates, no manual answer key needed.
- Pronunciation coaching uses standard North American English text-to-speech and speech recognition calibrated for children's voices.
- Free tier: 3 scans/day. Paid tier: unlimited scans.
- Ad-free, designed for children as young as 6.

## For academies (hagwons)
- Foreign Teacher (FT) logs a class session in under 30 seconds.
- Korean Teacher (KT) reviews an AI-drafted Korean-language KakaoTalk parent update before it's sent — human-in-the-loop, no auto-send.
- Directors get an aggregate dashboard across classes and teachers.
- Plans scale from solo tutors to multi-branch academy franchises.
